purpose: Diagnose why short and low-window-support events fail Formal G1 without training or changing production behavior.

frozen_population.event_population: all 234 training_eligibility=true events from approved eligibility artifact
frozen_population.participants: participant identities and outer folds from existing Formal G1 artifacts
frozen_population.scores: existing production participant-disjoint OOF/outer-validation scores only

geometry_metrics.ignored_window_count: dense_window_count - positive_window_count when verified by existing event audit
geometry_metrics.positive_window_temporal_positions: existing window start offsets relative to GT start when available without rebuilding production artifacts
geometry_metrics.selected_window_count: existing production score >= existing fold threshold
geometry_metrics.first_last_selected_offset: existing selected windows relative to GT interval; undefined when no selected window

short_event_audit.rule: Use the earliest supported failure mechanism in the frozen pipeline; do not classify from final IoU alone. Multiple mechanisms may be reported as F_MIXED.

descriptive_methods.participant_awareness: report within participant/fold where existing artifacts support it; no causal inference
descriptive_methods.logistic_models: not required; if used, descriptive only, no search or selection
descriptive_methods.multiple_testing: none; no hypothesis search or post-hoc production cutoff

B.support_definition: count hypothetical regular-grid window opportunities over the same approved representable raw-support spans/session boundaries used by the current eligibility/cache evidence
B.label_definition: apply frozen existing overlap/ignore rule arithmetically only
B.modeling: no feature extraction, no CandidateModel fit, no thresholding, no eventization

geometry_only_counterfactual.interpretation: The B result is geometry/label opportunity only. It cannot establish improved score support, eventization, or Formal G1 recall.

geometry_fragility.definition: For an observed event, remove the lowest-support selected evidence in arithmetic diagnostics and report whether the event's selected temporal coverage or qualifying interval support would disappear; do not alter production predictions.
geometry_fragility.interpretation: Fragility is descriptive evidence of support sensitivity, not a production simulation or causal estimate.

interpretation_criteria.WINDOW_GEOMETRY_PROBE_JUSTIFIED: Only if geometry-only evidence shows current 7.5 s stride materially limits opportunities for failing events and 3 s could increase label-support opportunities without changing labels; no model benefit may be claimed.
interpretation_criteria.WINDOW_GEOMETRY_PROBE_NOT_JUSTIFIED: If failures persist despite adequate opportunities, or the 3 s result is only theoretical without a defensible support-span basis.
interpretation_criteria.reopen_closed_branches: false unless new evidence directly contradicts frozen reviews
